notes: PY signing.py:156-527: order_type_to_wire, action_hash, phantom-agent L1 payload construction (construct_phantom_agent/l1_payload), user-signed payloads, multi-sig signing variants, per-action sign_* wrappers, recover_* helpers, float->wire/int conversions (float_to_wire/float_to_int_for_hashing/float_to_usd_int/float_to_int), order_request_to_order_wire. Signing trust boundary: local wallet signs actions; server verifies.

PY exchange.py:79-1229: Exchange class over API base; _post_action signs+sends; order/bulk/modify/market_open/market_close/cancel paths; fund-movement methods (usd_transfer, spot_transfer, vault/sub-account transfers, withdraw_from_bridge, token_delegate, send_asset); authority-granting methods (approve_agent, approve_builder_fee, convert_to_multi_sig_user, multi_sig); deploy/validator/c-signer admin flows; float amounts converted in signing helpers.
PY info.py:17-727: read-only Info queries; user_state/spot_user_state/open_orders/meta/candles; parses server JSON into typed structures. Trust boundary: server response deserialization.
PY websocket_manager.py:77-162: threaded WS client; subscribe/unsubscribe with subscription ids; on_message dispatch. Concurrency: threading.Thread + callbacks.

PY constants: MAINNET_API_URL https://api.hyperliquid.xyz, TESTNET_API_URL, LOCAL_API_URL http://localhost:3001. SDK SECURITY.md directs vulnerability reports to a Discord ticket (differs from program GitBook email route; program page governs).

Bridge2.sol:135-676: lockers/finalizers roles, lockerThreshold, epoch, totalValidatorPower, disputePeriodSeconds, blockDurationMillis; Deposit/RequestedWithdrawal/FinalizedWithdrawal/validator-set events; batchedRequestWithdrawals + finalizeWithdrawal with dispute period; checkValidatorSignatures quorum check; checkMessageNotUsed replay guard; updateValidatorSet/finalizeValidatorSetUpdate; modifyLocker/modifyFinalizer; changeDisputePeriodSeconds; invalidateWithdrawals; nonReentrant + whenNotPaused guards on finalize paths.

RS eip712.rs:7-10: Eip712 trait (domain, struct_hash, eip712_signing_hash). RS create_signature.rs:8-35: sign_l1_action + sign_typed_data; tests with fixed keys (context-only). RS exchange_client.rs:103-855: async client mirroring Python Exchange surface (transfers, orders, cancel/modify, leverage, approve_agent, withdraw_from_bridge, builder fees, schedule_cancel, claim_rewards). Deps: alloy 1.0 (dyn-abi, sol-types, signer-local), reqwest, serde/rmp-serde, tokio, tokio-tungstenite.

OBS websocket_server.rs:32-349: run_websocket_server(address, ignore_spot, compression_level); handle_socket + receive_client_message parse untrusted client subscription messages; snapshot/update/trade send paths. Trust boundary: unauthenticated WS clients -> server.

OBS order_book/mod.rs + multi_book.rs: add_order/add_order_before/cancel_order/modify_sz/to_snapshot/from_snapshot; linked_list.rs backing structure. State boundary: snapshot load + incremental updates must keep book consistent.

hyper-evm-sync fs.rs:41-136: read_blocks/read_abci_state/read_evm_state/snapshot_evm_state local file IO; fetch_block/download_blocks pull blocks from S3. CLI/filesystem provenance: dir paths + block ranges from CLI.
block-importer main.rs:53+: single binary entry; types.rs data model. Small surface.
